newsitem.title: BRAZIL: RESEARCH ALERT - Aracruz still a buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Aracruz still a buy.

text.p: -- Credit Lyonnais Securities said in a report its was reiterating its hold rating on Brazilian pulp and paper company Aracruz.
-- Analyst Matheus Tarzia said Aracruz reported net profits of $11.6 million for the first quarter, 56 percent below $26.3 million net profit posted in the same period last year.
-- He cited an expected recovery of world pulp and paper prices in the second half.

-- "The consolidation of the pulp and paper industry in Brazil will be good news for Aracruz and could lend momentum to the shares, although it is too early to assess the precise impact on the value of the stock," he said.
